findings.text: the comment's guarantee that genuine arrivals sharing a second are left alone is narrower than its wording, and the extraction's own output at the merged head shows the gap: 1 of 3066 nodes (reckon/review-of-an-orientation-stub-declares-no-wait) has no arrival at all because its earliest row at reckon-18dc8a86709b.events:3189 was swallowed as re-inventory, so a reader of the arrivals view sees that node materialise at a later state change.

the same-instant coverage pins the all-new wave and the all-known re-inventory but not the mixed group (a newly dispatched node sharing one stamp with an already-known member), which is the shape the burst rule gets wrong and the one the live corpus exhibits, so the remaining defect this review found has no fixture that would fail on its repair.

justifications.evidence: the gate is non-vacuous in both directions as I measured it myself rather than read it - tests/test_transition_extraction.py passes 9 of 9 at the merged head and fails exactly 2 of 9 with the pre-fix guard restored, and the recorded gate (30 passed against 21 sibling at base, 0 added) is consistent with the focused file I re-ran (9 passed in 0.28s).
justifications.fit: the change follows the module's own token-based idiom and re-derives the population comment from the function's own rows with its reading stamped at reckon/crew/query.py:381, but the sentence at reckon/crew/query.py:394 that genuine same-instant arrivals are left alone reads as a general guarantee and the extraction's own output at the merged head refutes it for the mixed group.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the one-token rendered arrival is now returned as its node's arrival - my re-measure at ff2ad80b finds 0 of 2314 rendered rows dropped (656 dropped at f17ab71c's parent), 614 of the 656 being a node's earliest row, against 1 of 3066 nodes still left with no arrival for the separate burst reason at reckon/crew/query.py:392.
justifications.scope_discipline: the run's five commits diff to exactly the four declared write paths against ee356a93 (reckon/crew/query.py +326, tests/test_transition_extraction.py +390, docs/plans/crew-observability-truth.html +23, docs/evidence/archive/crew-observability-truth-landed.html +74; 811 insertions and 2 deletions), and reckon/crew/query.py:634 defers CLI wiring to the surface that owns it.
